title: Identity and composition for ordinary completed-coefficient module pullbacks
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite coefficient extension E [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For every scheme X [def-pc-scheme] use the completed integral coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and the actual ordinary module pullback of [def-fix-qcqs-completion-ordinary-models], with independent scheme and coefficient universes. There is a natural isomorphism ordinaryPull(id_X) ≅ id. For any X --f--> Y --g--> Z there is a natural isomorphism ordinaryPull(f ≫ g) ≅ ordinaryPull(g) ⋙ ordinaryPull(f). No exactness, immersion, quasi-compactness or derived category is assumed.

theorem ordinaryCompletedPullCoherence
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] :
    (∀ X : Scheme.{t}, Nonempty (ordinaryPull l E (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 (Mod l E X none))) ∧
    (∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z),
      Nonempty (ordinaryPull l E (f ≫ g) ≅ ordinaryPull l E g ⋙ ordinaryPull l E f))
